summary: Verified new PUT /api/admin/media/{media_id} endpoint end-to-end via pytest (10/10 passing). Covered: admin login, partial update (title/thumbnail_url/is_premium/duration_sec), persistence via GET, invalid category -> 400, invalid meditation_category -> 400, missing token -> 401, non-admin -> 403, non-existent id -> 404, and post-test restore of original values. No bugs found; endpoint behaves as specified. _serialize_media correctly strips MongoDB _id from response.
critical_code_review_comments: PUT /api/admin/media/{media_id} implementation (server.py:1345-1362) is correct: uses exclude_unset for partial updates, allows clearing thumbnail_url, validates category and meditation_category against CATEGORIES/MEDITATION_CATEGORIES constants, returns 404 for missing id, and returns serialized doc via _serialize_media (which excludes MongoDB _id).
Auth is enforced correctly via Depends(require_admin) at the route level — non-admin gets 403, missing token gets 401.

Minor observation (non-blocking): the endpoint does not validate that duration_sec >= 0 or that media_url is a valid URL — if this becomes user-facing input for admins, consider Pydantic Field validators. Not part of this iteration's scope.
seed_data_creation: Tests register one ephemeral TEST_regular user for the non-admin auth check; no other seed data. Mutations on the target media are restored to original values in the final test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: PUT /api/admin/media/{id} is fully working. Admin creds: +393331234567 / Admin2026!. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration16_admin_media_update.py reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL from env/frontend .env and picks a real meditation from /api/media (auth required), so it is self-contained and can be rerun as regression.
